requirements.verifier_assertion: check_age_rule_selects_old_files: age rule with max_age_days correctly selects files older than threshold
check_dry_run_mutates_nothing: dry-run mode makes no file changes
check_apply_delete_removes_files: executing a plan with delete action removes files from disk
check_trash_uses_injected_func: trash action goes through the injectable trash_func
check_reference_files_never_evicted: files in reference directories are protected and never evicted
check_excluded_root_not_scanned: excluded directories are not scanned at all
check_keep_last_spares_best: keep_last preserves the N items sacrificed last in eviction order
check_oldest_first_ordering: oldest-first ordering evicts oldest modification time first
check_largest_first_ordering: largest-first ordering evicts largest allocation first
check_lru_ordering_uses_atime: lru ordering evicts least recently accessed by atime first
check_budget_drives_eviction: byte budget drives eviction measured by allocated_size
check_budget_respects_keep_last_then_overrides_when_needed: budget overrides keep_last when necessary but never evicts protected files
check_idempotent_reapply: re-running a plan on already-gone targets is not an error
check_stale_plan_refused: executor refuses plan when target changed on disk since plan was built
check_ignore_stale_skips: with ignore_stale=True, stale items are skipped and recorded
check_protected_path_hard_error: protected paths in plan cause ProtectedPathError before touching any file
check_policy_select_excludes_protected: protected files are always kept regardless of rules
check_rule_precedence_keep_beats_evict: on priority ties keep beats evict
check_rule_precedence_priority_wins: among matched rules the higher priority wins
check_default_action_keep: files matched by no rule default to keep
check_size_rule: size rule with min_size/max_size correctly selects files in range
check_idle_rule: idle rule with max_idle_days selects files idle longer than threshold
check_extension_and_glob_rules: extension and glob rules match files by suffix and filename pattern
check_deterministic_order: orderings are deterministic with stable tie-breaking
check_plan_is_pure: build_plan never touches the filesystem
check_plan_serialisable: plan as_dict returns a JSON-serializable dict
check_reclaimable_accounting: plan reports reclaimable_size and reclaimable_allocated correctly
check_layered_loader_merge_and_delete: merge_documents deep-merges with list append and null deletion
check_load_session_end_to_end: load_session merges documents and builds a ready SweepSession
check_unknown_rule_kind_rejected: unrecognized rule kind raises an Error
check_unknown_ordering_rejected: unrecognized ordering name raises an Error
check_invalid_scan_root_rejected: nonexistent or non-directory scan root raises at scan time
check_vanished_file_not_stale: a vanished file is recorded as already-gone, not treated as stale
must_include: vanished file is already-gone, not stale

requirements.verifier_assertion: check_size_filter_on_scan: ScanSpec min_size/max_size filter files at scan time
check_report_renders: SweepReport render_text returns non-empty text, as_dict has action_count, as_json returns JSON
check_apply_reuses_previewed_plan: preview and subsequent apply operate on the same snapshot and plan
